title: Supersedes wgl: Pocock-inspired passages are independently reworded, no MIT notice
description:
Context: decision agentic-devlopment-wgl concluded no MIT attribution was needed for PR #37 based on an 8-gram verbatim check. The PR #37 provenance review (subagents 20261120_2, 20261120_9, 20261120_10) found close paraphrase: same idea order, upstream conventions (GLOSSARY.md/GLOSSARY-MAP.md, _Avoid_, three ADR labels, to-spec sections, grilling rules, tdd/mocking lists) reworded with synonyms.
Decision (user, 2026-11-20): mattpocock_skills@abeeaf95 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Matt Pocock) is read for ideas only; this repository carries no copied or closely paraphrased expression and therefore no MIT notice. Remedy for PR #37: rewrite the flagged passages in our own structure, order, vocabulary and examples (task agentic-devlopment-2ec).

title: Single-agent reliability: commit-safe candidate proof and no-delegation fallbacks
description:
Goal: the Skills complete a cycle reliably on a single-agent host and keep exact-candidate proof valid across authorized commits.
Goals: G1 a commit made during Implement does not silently invalidate Test/Judge candidate evidence; one documented, testable rule decides how evidence binds across a commit. G2 Research and Plan readiness gates have a disclosed, limited-independence path when no subagent/worker is available, instead of stalling on a permission request.
Non-goals: waiving the independence required for acceptance (Judge/US acceptance still needs the review policy); changing candidate_identity.py hashing unless research shows it is required; automatic commits.

FR-1 (31k) Given an authorized commit after focused checks, when Test compares the candidate, then the Skills state either commit-after-Test/Judge or an exact rebind procedure (what is compared, what is excluded) so the outcome is deterministic, with a red-capable test.
FR-2 (qu2) Given no worker/subagent capability, when Research needs deeper investigation or Plan needs its global delegated challenge, then the coordinator proceeds directly and discloses reduced independence as a limit; Judge acceptance independence rules are unchanged.

title: Focused batch delivery with WIP limit and just-in-time refinement
description:
Goal: pull-based, WIP-limited delivery loop with rolling-wave (just-in-time) planning, so agents finish work instead of spreading effort across epics.
Goals: G1 finish started work (Done or explicit blocker) before pulling new work. G2 focus agent context on one epic and one batch. G3 create detailed tasks only for near-term work.
Non-goals: automatic closure without DoD evidence/authority; automatic session launch, commit or push; replacing Beads as task truth.
Requirements:
FR-1 Single active epic: only tasks of the epic in delivery are pulled; switching needs an explicit user decision.
FR-2 WIP = active batch: only batch tasks are in_progress; nothing else claimed or left half-open.
FR-3 Batch selection: batch = all ready, unblocked tasks of the active epic that can run independently, bounded only by the host's subagent concurrency limit (e.g. Goose's configured maximum); Skills never set or override a cap. Independent tasks run in parallel subagents with disjoint writable paths.
FR-4 Finish before pull: no task outside the batch is pulled until the batch closes or a blocker is reported.
FR-5 DoD-gated closure: close only after Test evidence + Judge accepted + current closure authority; otherwise stay open with named blocker and restart action.
FR-6 No speculative tasks: epics not next in line keep goal, outcomes, rough scope only, no child tasks.
FR-7 Just-in-time refinement: when the active epic has no ready tasks for the next batch, automatically propose Research->Plan refinement for it (or the next epic in order); horizon one batch ahead; tracker writes only with tracker-write authority.
FR-8 Discovered work: recorded as open follow-up linked discovered-from source; never claimed nor added to the batch.
Decisions (user, 2026-11-19): D1 no plugin cap, host concurrency limit governs; D2 refine one batch ahead; D3 automatic proposal, writes need authority; D4 blocked task is unclaimed back to open with named blocker, rest of batch continues; D5 disjoint paths by default, worktree only on collision and with authority.
Change rule: loop/route/tool changes update docs/skill-flow.md and tests/test_skill_flow.py together.

description:

AC1 Given no verified grant, When a task closes, Then behavior is unchanged: commit proposed only, no push (level 0 default).

title: Extract one conditional shared capability without widening delivery procedure
description:
## Why
Maintainers need readable, restartable tickets without loading the full authoring procedure for routine tracker operations. The requested solution is a conditional autonomous capability, not an additional mandatory development phase.

## Outcome and scope
Source extraction and independent narrow review are complete: seven portable phase Skills plus optional task-authoring (eight shipped capabilities). Creation/description repair loads the capability; routine reads, claims, progress and closure stay with the caller. The bounded implementation covered 20 owned paths recorded in the 2026-11-14 implementation note, including the new contained Skill/resources, phase routing, product documentation, production discovery and focused tests. plugin.json and seven-phase evaluation suites were unchanged.
This is source-authoring completion only, not Git integration, installation, behavioral effectiveness or release acceptance. No new implementation work is implied.

## Success criteria
The acceptance field is canonical: R-1..R-3 preserve the historical research/plan phase; FR-1..FR-6 specify the subsequently authorized source extraction. R-3's no-source-change restriction applied to that original phase. The later user-approved implementation superseded the planning-only execution limit, not its preservation requirements.

## Premises and hypotheses
Observed in recorded source evidence: conditional routing, contained native Beads bridge, verified-ID/readback or honest proposal/error, bounded STOP, exact eight-capability inventory and unchanged seven-phase obligations. Eight full guidance copies intentionally retain portable fallback; physical deduplication and reduced context/time or improved agent effectiveness are not established.

## Execution and result
Research33 delivered the comparison/plan; implementation35 delivered the scoped source; independent reviewer41 accepted FR-1..FR-6 for candidate 5a4aacb4c1498349e652dcbde4671f5df8ec4333178a7b99c58ae18f08561856. Recorded checks: 59 focused static checks, payload inventory (132 files), official standalone Skill validation and diff check passed; no full suite or behavioral campaign claimed. Original dirty hunks/files and symlink were preserved as recorded.
Evidence: /dev/shm/task5by-20261114-35/{scope.json,owned.diff,results.json,before.json,after.json}; accessible but volatile. Reviewer acceptance and limits remain in dated notes. This consolidation inspected metadata/notes, not a fresh source acceptance or test rerun.

## Dependencies and decisions
No existing native parent or prerequisite edges; none created. This local extraction is not part of the already published cs7 source. Maintainer must decide whether/when to authorize integration and administrative closure; historical implementation/review approval is not renewed Git or closure authority.

## Restart
Read the final reviewer41 note and owned.diff/results.json to identify the already reviewed source slice. Ask the maintainer for an explicit integration/closure decision; stop without repeating implementation or review unless the candidate changes or evidence becomes unavailable.

title: Ground application testing in product guarantees and marginal defect detection
description:
## Why
User feedback 2026-10-28 reports disproportionate AI-generated suites (>500 tests on small products), redundant costly campaigns and green suites with weak or circular oracles. These are supplied historical observations, not measured defects in this repository. Product users need meaningful confidence with proportionate testability and maintenance cost.
## What / scope
Improve source Plan, Implement, Test and Judge guidance and contained resources; add focused source-contract checks and hypothetical evaluation scenarios. Start from product guarantees, independently observable incorrect behavior and marginal detection value. Include retain/merge/remove/replace decisions, assertion discrimination, risk-based errors, minimal public seams, and required CI wall time versus aggregate compute cost.
## Non-goals
No audit/removal of another product suite, fixed test-count ceiling, invented performance targets, live A/B evaluation, runtime/hook/installed-plugin changes, commit/push/merge/install/publication/closure/sync. Existing unrelated tasks remain untouched.
## Inputs / order
1. Current user request and Michael Bromley article https://www.michaelbromley.co.uk/blog/the-problem-with-your-ai-tests/ (read 2026-10-28).
2. AGENTS.md and current clean source HEAD; source skills/plan,implement,test,judge entrypoints; contained requirements, authorization and review policies.
3. tests/AGENTS.md and existing eval formats. Installed creator is read-only validation tooling, not the candidate.
## Verification / ownership / restart
One coordinator goose; exclusive source paths recorded in notes. Non-behavioral authoring criteria; FR N/A. Small-task mode selected before changes; limited author self-review for source quality only, independent review required before broader US/release acceptance. Focused red-capable static checks, relevant repository regressions, payload/link/JSON checks and official creator validation. No application CI speed or agent behavioral gain claimed. Numeric performance acceptance targets unresolved for downstream products. Read this task and current tree/ownership/authority before restart.
acceptance_criteria: TQ-1 / user: Planning and test selection require product-guarantee -> distinct incorrect observable behavior -> independent oracle -> cheapest valid check, without preserving legacy count or fixed quotas. TQ-2 / user+article: Test guidance rejects mock self-validation, copied expected logic, weak exact-outcome assertions and success/error ambiguity; includes risk-relevant errors and red-capable discrimination with honest evidence levels. TQ-3 / user: Authorized suite rationalization records retain/merge/remove/replace with lost/preserved guarantee, detection value, actual/proposed status and relevant verification; never weakens product acceptance. TQ-4 / user: Testability stays at minimal meaningful public seams without speculative abstraction; expensive campaign repetition requires distinct risk/confidence question and budget/stop. TQ-5 / user: Handoff reports defects actually detected versus hypothetical, remaining gaps and required end-to-end CI wall time/environment separately from summed test durations/compute; unavailable measurements remain unknown. TQ-6 / repo: Contained English resources, relevant hypothetical scenarios and focused independent-source checks validate with existing safeguards preserved; static evidence is not agent effectiveness or acceptance.

title: Make task tickets readable and restartable
description:
## Why
Current tickets bury the purpose in dense operational paragraphs, making review and restart difficult.

## What
Add portable ticket-authoring guidance and restructure uor.10 and its two children without changing scope or acceptance.

## How
Use a contained conditional reference, source regression checks and verified Beads readbacks.

## Scope and non-goals
Own seven ticket references/entrypoint links, the Beads bridge and source tests; preserve all existing dirty hunks. Only reformat three existing tickets. No Goose writes, commits, pushes, closure, export or sync.

## Acceptance criteria
Canonical criteria: TK-1 through TK-4 in the acceptance field; unchanged.

## Reading references
Required inspected source, current working tree; revalidate identity on restart.
1. skills/plan/references/ticket-authoring.md v1.1.0: procedure, example and readiness.
2. tests/test_ticket_authoring.py: static regression checks.
3. skills/plan/SKILL.md: task frontier and tracker writes.
2. skills/plan/references/requirements-baseline.md: criteria and GWT.
3. skills/plan/references/beads-integration.md: ownership/readback.
4. skills/research/references/knowledge-pointers.md: ordered provenance-bound inputs.

## Verification
Static source tests, inventory and seven creator checks; limited self-review, no behavioral acceptance. Resume this task after root/branch/ownership checks; preserve previous report/context work.

TK-1/2: inspect rendered sections/scenarios and source tests; TK-3: identical contained copies and conditional links; TK-4: original/readback criteria/native-field comparisons in notes. Static/manual checks only.

## Ownership and dependencies
Coordinator/native assignee owns writes; uor parent means hierarchy. Local cleanup authorized; no Git/install/Goose writes.

## Restart
Review C1-C3 correction and scoped verification; close this source/manual ticket scope only. No future-agent, parent or release acceptance.
acceptance_criteria:
## TK-1: Visible purpose and structure
Given: a new or updated ticket
When: its description is prepared
Then: Why/What/How, scope, reading references, verification and restart are separate readable sections.

## TK-2: Verifiable criteria
Given: behavioral requirements
When: acceptance is written
Then: stable IDs map explicit Given/When/Then to checks, including relevant boundaries; non-behavioral tasks use verifiable deliverables.

## TK-3: Portable guidance
Given: standalone Skills and optional Beads
When: tickets are authored or repaired
Then: a contained conditional reference applies without forcing Beads on other trackers.

## TK-4: Preservation
Given: uor.10 and its two children
When: descriptions and acceptance presentation are repaired
Then: IDs, owners, statuses, dependencies, original criteria and notes are preserved and read back.
